metrics.label: Relative LCC size
metrics.description: Fraction of disease proteins in the largest connected component (LCC). Range [0, 1]. Paper median: 0.21.
metrics.interpretation: Higher values mean more disease-associated proteins sit in one connected pathway component rather than many fragments.

metrics.label: Network density
metrics.description: Edge density = 2|E| / (|V|(|V|−1)). Range [0, 1]. Paper median: 0.07.
metrics.interpretation: Higher density means more PPI edges among disease-associated proteins.

metrics.label: Distance between pathway components
metrics.description: Average shortest-path length between disconnected pathway components in the full PPI network. Paper median: ~2.9.
metrics.interpretation: Lower distances mean disconnected pathway pieces sit closer together in the interactome. Undefined when the pathway is a single component.

metrics.label: Conductance
metrics.description: Fraction of edges leaving the pathway vs total: |Bd| / (|Bd| + 2|Ed|). Range [0, 1]. Paper median: 0.96.
metrics.interpretation: High conductance means the pathway is poorly separated from the rest of the PPI network.

metrics.interpretation: Smaller p-values indicate disease proteins occupy more clustered positions in the interactome than expected by chance.

metrics.label: Modularity
metrics.description: Newman's modularity Q for the disease-vs-rest partition.
metrics.interpretation: Values near zero mean disease proteins do not form a well-defined module relative to the rest of the network.

metrics.label: Relative LCC size
metrics.description: Fraction of disease proteins in the largest connected component (LCC). Range [0, 1]. Paper median: 0.21.
metrics.interpretation: Higher values mean more disease-associated proteins sit in one connected pathway component rather than many fragments.

metrics.label: Network density
metrics.description: Edge density = 2|E| / (|V|(|V|−1)). Range [0, 1]. Paper median: 0.07.
metrics.interpretation: Higher density means more PPI edges among disease-associated proteins.

metrics.label: Distance between pathway components

metrics.label: Conductance
metrics.description: Fraction of edges leaving the pathway vs total: |Bd| / (|Bd| + 2|Ed|). Range [0, 1]. Paper median: 0.96.
metrics.interpretation: High conductance means the pathway is poorly separated from the rest of the PPI network.

metrics.interpretation: Smaller p-values indicate disease proteins occupy more clustered positions in the interactome than expected by chance.

metrics.label: Modularity
metrics.description: Newman's modularity Q for the disease-vs-rest partition.

metrics.label: Relative LCC size
metrics.description: Fraction of disease proteins in the largest connected component (LCC). Range [0, 1]. Paper median: 0.21.
metrics.interpretation: Higher values mean more disease-associated proteins sit in one connected pathway component rather than many fragments.

metrics.label: Network density
metrics.description: Edge density = 2|E| / (|V|(|V|−1)). Range [0, 1]. Paper median: 0.07.
metrics.interpretation: Higher density means more PPI edges among disease-associated proteins.

metrics.label: Distance between pathway components
metrics.description: Average shortest-path length between disconnected pathway components in the full PPI network. Paper median: ~2.9.
metrics.interpretation: Lower distances mean disconnected pathway pieces sit closer together in the interactome. Undefined when the pathway is a single component.

metrics.label: Conductance
metrics.description: Fraction of edges leaving the pathway vs total: |Bd| / (|Bd| + 2|Ed|). Range [0, 1]. Paper median: 0.96.
metrics.interpretation: High conductance means the pathway is poorly separated from the rest of the PPI network.

metrics.interpretation: Smaller p-values indicate disease proteins occupy more clustered positions in the interactome than expected by chance.

metrics.label: Modularity
metrics.description: Newman's modularity Q for the disease-vs-rest partition.
metrics.interpretation: Values near zero mean disease proteins do not form a well-defined module relative to the rest of the network.

metrics.label: Relative LCC size
metrics.description: Fraction of disease proteins in the largest connected component (LCC). Range [0, 1]. Paper median: 0.21.
metrics.interpretation: Higher values mean more disease-associated proteins sit in one connected pathway component rather than many fragments.

metrics.label: Network density
metrics.description: Edge density = 2|E| / (|V|(|V|−1)). Range [0, 1]. Paper median: 0.07.
metrics.interpretation: Higher density means more PPI edges among disease-associated proteins.

metrics.label: Distance between pathway components

metrics.label: Conductance
metrics.description: Fraction of edges leaving the pathway vs total: |Bd| / (|Bd| + 2|Ed|). Range [0, 1]. Paper median: 0.96.
metrics.interpretation: High conductance means the pathway is poorly separated from the rest of the PPI network.

metrics.interpretation: Smaller p-values indicate disease proteins occupy more clustered positions in the interactome than expected by chance.

metrics.label: Modularity
metrics.description: Newman's modularity Q for the disease-vs-rest partition.

metrics.label: Relative LCC size
metrics.description: Fraction of disease proteins in the largest connected component (LCC). Range [0, 1]. Paper median: 0.21.
metrics.interpretation: Higher values mean more disease-associated proteins sit in one connected pathway component rather than many fragments.

metrics.label: Network density
metrics.description: Edge density = 2|E| / (|V|(|V|−1)). Range [0, 1]. Paper median: 0.07.
metrics.interpretation: Higher density means more PPI edges among disease-associated proteins.

metrics.label: Distance between pathway components
metrics.description: Average shortest-path length between disconnected pathway components in the full PPI network. Paper median: ~2.9.
metrics.interpretation: Lower distances mean disconnected pathway pieces sit closer together in the interactome. Undefined when the pathway is a single component.

metrics.label: Conductance
metrics.description: Fraction of edges leaving the pathway vs total: |Bd| / (|Bd| + 2|Ed|). Range [0, 1]. Paper median: 0.96.
metrics.interpretation: High conductance means the pathway is poorly separated from the rest of the PPI network.

metrics.interpretation: Smaller p-values indicate disease proteins occupy more clustered positions in the interactome than expected by chance.

metrics.label: Modularity
metrics.description: Newman's modularity Q for the disease-vs-rest partition.
metrics.interpretation: Values near zero mean disease proteins do not form a well-defined module relative to the rest of the network.

metrics.label: Relative LCC size
metrics.description: Fraction of disease proteins in the largest connected component (LCC). Range [0, 1]. Paper median: 0.21.
metrics.interpretation: Higher values mean more disease-associated proteins sit in one connected pathway component rather than many fragments.

metrics.label: Network density
metrics.description: Edge density = 2|E| / (|V|(|V|−1)). Range [0, 1]. Paper median: 0.07.
metrics.interpretation: Higher density means more PPI edges among disease-associated proteins.

metrics.label: Distance between pathway components

metrics.label: Conductance
metrics.description: Fraction of edges leaving the pathway vs total: |Bd| / (|Bd| + 2|Ed|). Range [0, 1]. Paper median: 0.96.
metrics.interpretation: High conductance means the pathway is poorly separated from the rest of the PPI network.

metrics.interpretation: Smaller p-values indicate disease proteins occupy more clustered positions in the interactome than expected by chance.

metrics.label: Modularity
metrics.description: Newman's modularity Q for the disease-vs-rest partition.

metrics.label: Relative LCC size
metrics.description: Fraction of disease proteins in the largest connected component (LCC). Range [0, 1]. Paper median: 0.21.
metrics.interpretation: Higher values mean more disease-associated proteins sit in one connected pathway component rather than many fragments.

metrics.label: Network density
metrics.description: Edge density = 2|E| / (|V|(|V|−1)). Range [0, 1]. Paper median: 0.07.
metrics.interpretation: Higher density means more PPI edges among disease-associated proteins.

metrics.label: Distance between pathway components
metrics.description: Average shortest-path length between disconnected pathway components in the full PPI network. Paper median: ~2.9.
metrics.interpretation: Lower distances mean disconnected pathway pieces sit closer together in the interactome. Undefined when the pathway is a single component.

metrics.label: Conductance
metrics.description: Fraction of edges leaving the pathway vs total: |Bd| / (|Bd| + 2|Ed|). Range [0, 1]. Paper median: 0.96.
metrics.interpretation: High conductance means the pathway is poorly separated from the rest of the PPI network.

metrics.interpretation: Smaller p-values indicate disease proteins occupy more clustered positions in the interactome than expected by chance.

metrics.label: Modularity
metrics.description: Newman's modularity Q for the disease-vs-rest partition.
metrics.interpretation: Values near zero mean disease proteins do not form a well-defined module relative to the rest of the network.

metrics.label: Relative LCC size
metrics.description: Fraction of disease proteins in the largest connected component (LCC). Range [0, 1]. Paper median: 0.21.
metrics.interpretation: Higher values mean more disease-associated proteins sit in one connected pathway component rather than many fragments.

metrics.label: Network density
metrics.description: Edge density = 2|E| / (|V|(|V|−1)). Range [0, 1]. Paper median: 0.07.
metrics.interpretation: Higher density means more PPI edges among disease-associated proteins.

metrics.label: Distance between pathway components

metrics.label: Conductance
metrics.description: Fraction of edges leaving the pathway vs total: |Bd| / (|Bd| + 2|Ed|). Range [0, 1]. Paper median: 0.96.
metrics.interpretation: High conductance means the pathway is poorly separated from the rest of the PPI network.

metrics.interpretation: Smaller p-values indicate disease proteins occupy more clustered positions in the interactome than expected by chance.

metrics.label: Modularity
metrics.description: Newman's modularity Q for the disease-vs-rest partition.

metrics.label: Relative LCC size
metrics.description: Fraction of disease proteins in the largest connected component (LCC). Range [0, 1]. Paper median: 0.21.
metrics.interpretation: Higher values mean more disease-associated proteins sit in one connected pathway component rather than many fragments.

metrics.label: Network density
metrics.description: Edge density = 2|E| / (|V|(|V|−1)). Range [0, 1]. Paper median: 0.07.
metrics.interpretation: Higher density means more PPI edges among disease-associated proteins.

metrics.label: Distance between pathway components
metrics.description: Average shortest-path length between disconnected pathway components in the full PPI network. Paper median: ~2.9.
metrics.interpretation: Lower distances mean disconnected pathway pieces sit closer together in the interactome. Undefined when the pathway is a single component.

metrics.label: Conductance
metrics.description: Fraction of edges leaving the pathway vs total: |Bd| / (|Bd| + 2|Ed|). Range [0, 1]. Paper median: 0.96.
metrics.interpretation: High conductance means the pathway is poorly separated from the rest of the PPI network.

metrics.interpretation: Smaller p-values indicate disease proteins occupy more clustered positions in the interactome than expected by chance.

metrics.label: Modularity
metrics.description: Newman's modularity Q for the disease-vs-rest partition.
metrics.interpretation: Values near zero mean disease proteins do not form a well-defined module relative to the rest of the network.

metrics.label: Relative LCC size
metrics.description: Fraction of disease proteins in the largest connected component (LCC). Range [0, 1]. Paper median: 0.21.
metrics.interpretation: Higher values mean more disease-associated proteins sit in one connected pathway component rather than many fragments.

metrics.label: Network density
metrics.description: Edge density = 2|E| / (|V|(|V|−1)). Range [0, 1]. Paper median: 0.07.
metrics.interpretation: Higher density means more PPI edges among disease-associated proteins.

metrics.label: Distance between pathway components
